spans.s:
m. (-टः)
1 The foundation of a house, &c.
2 Uniting, mixing.
f. (-टा)
1 A woman having a beard.
2 A female servant or slave.
(-टी)
A large alligator.
E.
पुट to shine, aff. अच्.

m. (-लः)
1 A reed, (Arundo tibialis, Rox.)
2 A sort of grass, (Saccharum spontaneum.)
3 A fish.
E.
पोट uniting (with the wind), गल to go, aff. अच्, waving in the wind.
